verdict.rationale: Deepgram has no built-in natural-language command interface of its own. It does ship a first-party MCP server inside the dg CLI that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs, and the CLI auto-detects agent environments such as Claude Code, Aider and Codex. That lets users operate Deepgram through natural-language prompts, though the language understanding happens in a third-party agent. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the product, documentation of which operations are reachable via natural-language prompts through MCP, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The dg CLI includes a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs.
The CLI auto-detects AI agent environments, including Claude Code, Aider, and OpenAI Codex, and adjusts its behavior
